description:
Expandi is the go-to-market platform sales teams use to turn buying signals into relevant conversations, on LinkedIn and email. This connector lets the AI you already use work inside your own Expandi account: describe an audience and it builds the lead list; give it a goal and it drafts the whole campaign, steps, timing and copy; enrich leads, move them across campaigns, and ask why a campaign stalled and get the reason.

You stay in control. Campaigns build as drafts you activate, replies draft for your approval, and the connector never sends a message or activates a campaign on its own. It works within the limits, warm-up and permissions you've already set in Expandi.
